objects.name: mx_server snowshoe mail fleet
objects.description: Templated SMTP fleet (O=mx_server certificates, Caddy, Kafka with private Kafka-Cluster-CA) on OVH BYOIP (IPXO-leased), OVH dedicated, H4Y, Tier.Net, Hetzner and US-hosted nodes. 2,463 hosts, 93 domains. v2.0: 8 BYOIP /24s mapped to 8 OVH dedicated servers (3 Kafka brokers, 5 workers) by SSH host key.
